35mm manual SLR with 50mm f/1.8 lens

Price: $220
Condition: Working, with one fault noted below.

A late 1970s manual SLR with its 50mm f/1.8 lens. It was tested with film in February 2026 and the photos came out sharp and evenly exposed.

The light meter reads one stop under. It is easy to allow for, or you can use a phone app to meter.

Shutter speeds sound right and the viewfinder is clean. Postage available, or pickup from Glebe.

Rare vintage camera that every serious photographer and enthusiast will want to own!

$300. Works.
